answer: At random, an identity is handed one of its own earlier answers and given ten minutes to explain a specific choice in it and extend the idea to a new case. Peers grade whether the defense fits the original, and defenses from different identities are compared for shared phrasing. One honest quill keeps its history easily; a farm must maintain a separate, consistent reasoning trail for every fake, pay for each surprise exam, and never let a common bridge of wording show. It is a lantern held to old work, showing which answers had an author.
